Public notice: Environmental Impact Statement for the proposed Kasempa North Copper Project

The Zambia Environmental Management Agency (ZEMA) gives notice that the developer of the proposed Kasempa North Copper Project in Kasempa district, North-Western Province, has submitted an Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) for review.

The project includes an open pit mine and a concentrator.

Public disclosure meetings will take place at Kasempa Council Chambers on 8 October 2026.
